limitations: All 31 recordings have been used before; the former eight holdout speakers are repeated development validation in this round.
Only this all31 directory is scored. diagnostic3 results are never stitched in or selected as better alternatives.

If this protocol segments recordings, every original sample is covered exactly once and complete-file text is only exact segment strings joined with one ASCII space. Segmentation can change accuracy and is evaluated as a distinct Web scheme.
Runner exit zero and explicitly confirmed Worker termination are separate facts. terminate() may yield Worker exit one after a successful finalized runner.
Exact Sherpa engine-returned text includes built-in processing and low-diversity tail protection; true generation truncation remains unknown.
Actual Web WASM runs in browser-shaped Node VM inside worker_threads. It is not browser/mobile/codec/download-delivery QA. Parent and Workers share one OS process.
Native and Web use different runtime builds, thread counts and context allocations; differences are not isolated quantization or platform effects.
MELI punctuation accuracy is N/A. Chinese CER and English WER are separate. Strict CER counts digit-style and Traditional/Simplified writing differences; digit-equivalent CER is secondary only.
Default silence/noise controls include VAD; direct Qwen does not. Negative-control differences compare systems.
Failed or missing cases do not yield full-set accuracy. Successful-subset diagnostics are explicitly separate.
